body: A bucket and capped water bottle hold the same gray foam. Yellow spray dust circles both rims, above the waterline.
title: bitter water saved beside the pump
gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.

title: A queue for water
body: They shut the pump after assigning the households one pail apiece. More people came from the road, but their names belonged to a different district on the list. My father shared his pail while the clerk went to find another page.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
